shared_elements: low-relief carved figures in strict profile
procession/row of standing human figures moving in one direction
bearded male figures with elaborate hair and long garments
horizontal frieze band of repeated figures
justification: Both are low-relief friezes of bearded male figures in strict profile, arranged in an overlapping procession moving in a single direction, holding staff-like or hand-held implements, with the same conventions of patterned hair/beard, long fringed robes and rank-file overlap. The clearest difference is that B includes horses, a chariot with a spoked wheel, archers and a narrative triumph/battle context, whereas A is a purely static file of unarmed attendants without animals or vehicles.
